reason: Ice-cold naengmyeon sounds perfect on a hot Honolulu afternoon, but I plan my meals from Japanese guidebooks and blogs before the trip, and I have never seen this place in them. With only a few days, I don't want to spend a meal on a restaurant I can't check first.
objection: I don't know if it is actually good, and nobody I follow has written about it. Getting there from Waikiki also sounds like a hassle, and I hear parking on Kapiolani is bad.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it recommended on a Japanese travel blog or Instagram account, with photos of the noodles and easy directions from Waikiki by bus or a short taxi ride.
